claims.label: Defense Moves to Continue Preliminary Hearing
claims.claim: The defense has filed a motion seeking to continue the preliminary hearing currently scheduled for May 2026.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain certified copy of the filed motion and confirm filing date and assigned judge.

claims.label: ATF Unable to Identify Bullet to Rifle
claims.claim: The ATF was unable to identify the bullet recovered at autopsy to the rifle allegedly tied to Tyler Robinson, according to an ATF summary report provided to the defense.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full ATF case file and protocols referenced as outstanding in the filing; verify whether the conclusion is "inconclusive" or a definitive non-match.

claims.label: FBI Conducting Second Comparative Bullet and Bullet Lead Analyses
claims.claim: The state has indicated that the FBI is in the process of conducting a second comparative bullet analysis and a bullet lead analysis, neither of which is yet complete.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain status filing or prosecutorial disclosure regarding timeline of FBI secondary analyses.

claims.label: FBI Discontinued Comparative Bullet Lead Analysis in 2005
claims.claim: The FBI discontinued its comparative bullet lead analysis program in 2005 after admitting the technique lacked definitive scientific, statistical, and interpretive validity, and the technique was used in approximately 2,500 cases.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the FBI's 2005 NAS report and PCast/NIST forensic science reviews; confirm current formal FBI policy position on CBLA use.

claims.label: Autopsy Report Delayed to Defense
claims.claim: The autopsy report, completed September 16, 2025, was not provided to the defense until November 13, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain defense correspondence log and prosecution's transmission records to verify dates.

claims.label: Autopsy Photographs Delayed to Defense
claims.claim: Autopsy photographs taken on September 10, 2025 were not produced to the defense until March 18, 2026.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain defense correspondence log and prosecution's transmission records to verify dates.

claims.label: ~600,000 Files / ~12 TB Dumped at March 12, 2026 Conference
claims.claim: At the March 12, 2026 conference, the state provided the defense with a hard drive containing approximately 12 terabytes of data and over 600,000 files.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the filing's exhibit list and any hard-drive transmission log.

claims.label: Prior Discovery Volume Before March 12, 2026 Conference
claims.claim: Prior to the March 12, 2026 conference, the defense had received approximately 20,000 files (excluding digital electronic discovery), 61,500 pages, 31 hours of audio, more than 5,000 video files, and more than 700 hours of video.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with case docket and prosecution's discovery log.

claims.label: Three Witness Categories at Preliminary Hearing
claims.claim: The state indicated it intends to present at the preliminary hearing three categories of evidence: conclusory forensic DNA and ballistics reports authored by the FBI and ATF; phone and social media data testimony; and testimony by Tyler Robinson's parents and roommate.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify witness list filing and prosecution's stated intention to proceed without supporting expert testimony.

claims.label: Andrew Kolb Tweet: Coroner Found Bullet Beneath Skin
claims.claim: In a September 20, 2025 X/Twitter post, Andrew Kolb wrote that the coroner found the bullet just beneath Charlie Kirk's skin.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and verify the original X post timestamp, account status, and the underlying autopsy report's final disposition language.

claims.label: Andrew Kolb Tweet: "Man of Steel" Surgeon Quote
claims.claim: In the same September 20, 2025 post, Andrew Kolb attributed a quote to a surgeon who worked on Charlie Kirk at the hospital stating that Kirk's bone density was so healthy that he was "like the man of steel" and that it was a miracle no one behind Kirk was struck.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and depose the surgeon; compare quote against operative notes and any recorded statements.

claims.label: Long Beach Airport Adjacent to Joint Forces Air Base
claims.claim: Long Beach Airport is approximately a 10–15 minute drive from a Joint Forces Air Base in Los Alamitos, CA, which is also used by the California National Guard and hosts annual air shows.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm base location via public military base directories; cross-reference flight manifests for July 14, 2025.

claims.label: Kim Haven Asserts Doctors Do Not Publicly Announce Deaths
claims.claim: Kim Haven, identifying as a nurse, asserted in a YouTube comment that doctors do not come out and publicly announce a patient's death, but instead pull the next of kin into a separate room.
claims.investigative_direction: Review standard hospital death-disclosure protocols; obtain Frank Turek's original statement context.

claims.label: Kim Haven Asserts Frank Turek Is "Absolutely a Liar"
claims.claim: Kim Haven asserted in her YouTube comment that Frank Turek is "absolutely a liar" regarding his hospital account.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and locate Frank Turek's original statement; reconcile with hospital staff logs.

claims.label: Host Concurs With Kim Haven's Assessment
claims.claim: The host concurs with Kim Haven's assessment that Frank Turek's account of announcing "He's dead. He's dead" within ~30 minutes of hospital arrival is implausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare timing against typical trauma-team workflow; obtain official timeline from hospital.

claims.label: Host Concurs That FBI CBLA Revival Is Suspicious
claims.claim: The host concurs that the FBI's planned revival of comparative bullet lead analysis – a technique discontinued in 2005 – in the Tyler Robinson case is indicative of federal corruption.
claims.investigative_direction: Review any FBI lab protocol authorizing CBLA reintroduction; compare to 2009 NAS forensic science recommendations.

claims.label: Host Disagrees With "Man of Steel" Medical Framing
claims.claim: The host rejects the medical plausibility of Andrew Kolb's "man of steel"/bone-density framing in the September 20, 2025 tweet, asserting it is not how serious trauma surgeons communicate.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain forensic pathology review of any surgeon communications; verify whether such a quote was ever formally attested.

claims.label: Host says the scene was paved over quickly to protect the pass-through narrative
claims.claim: The host says she believes the shooting scene was paved over so quickly because the narrative was supposed to be that the .30-06 round passed through Charlie Kirk, which she says it did not.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the timeline and work orders for the repaving of the scene; compare against the ballistic findings on whether the round exited.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I believe that that is the true reason why they moved to pave over the scene so quickly because that was supposed to be the narrative.

claims.label: Kirk shot at 12:23 p.m. Mountain Time on September 10
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was shot on September 10 at 12:23 p.m. Mountain Time.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the 911 log, CAD records and event video timestamps for the time of the shot.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie Kirk was shot on September 10th, 12:23 p. m. uh in the afternoon Mountain Time.

claims.label: Farnsworth grabbed Kirk's chair and removed the SD card minutes after the shot
claims.claim: The host says that about four minutes after Charlie Kirk was carried to the SUV, Tarro Farnsworth came down from his recording position, took the chair Kirk had been sitting in, stood on it and removed the SD card from the camera behind Kirk's head.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain scene video showing Farnsworth's movements and the chain of custody of the SD card from that camera.
claims.transcript_snippet: He returns to the crime scene and violates it. More specifically, he grabs the very chair that Charlie Kirk had just been sitting in

claims.label: Farnsworth's AV company has worked TPUSA events for over a decade
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth runs the audio-visual company Turning Point employs for its big events, has used it for over a decade, and that he normally does not attend college events, but that the company was trying something different that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA vendor contracts and prior event staffing records for the AV company.
claims.transcript_snippet: the man who runs the audio-visual company that Turning Point employs, maybe you've used them for over a decade for their big events, and he's never goes to these college events

claims.label: Host says Kolvet's theft explanation for the SD card fails because the camera was left
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet later explained that Farnsworth acted heroically because students were going to steal items from the table, and she says this is false because Farnsworth left the expensive camera and took only the roughly $15 SD card.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's public explanation with the scene video showing which items were on the table and what was taken.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yeah, we we know Andrew Kolvats lying because Tarro did not take the expensive camera.

claims.label: Host called Farnsworth on September 17, one week after the shooting
claims.claim: The host says she decided on September 17, exactly one week after the assassination, to call Farnsworth.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's call log and any recording or notes of the September 17 call.
claims.transcript_snippet: I decided on September 17th, exactly 1 week after Charlie's assassination, to reach to reach out to him. I called him.

claims.label: Host says Farnsworth stammered and said he took the footage to protect Erika
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth was exceedingly nervous, stammered through nonsensical excuses, and said he wanted to secure the footage so Erika would not see Charlie being shot in 4K, which the host calls a lie because the footage was already circulating and a closer camera would have captured more.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Farnsworth to state under oath why he chose that camera and what instruction he acted on.
claims.transcript_snippet: I wanted to secure the footage for Erika so that uh she wouldn't have to see the footage of Charlie being shot in 4K

claims.label: Host says the back-camera footage showed almost no blood
claims.claim: The host says that once she saw the footage from the camera behind Charlie it had no blood, only a drop on his back as he went down, which she calls the mildest shot of all.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original back-camera file and compare it with the front and side footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: once I actually saw the footage, it had no blood.

claims.label: Host speculates the footage was hidden because it showed the bullet did not exit
claims.claim: The host says she speculates the SD card was removed to hide that the bullet did not go through Charlie, which she believes was meant to remain a state secret, because the public had assumed a .30-06 from about 150 yards had gone through.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the autopsy report and the back-camera footage to establish whether there was an exit wound.
claims.transcript_snippet: they were hiding was the fact that the bullet did not go through. Did not pierce through Charlie.

claims.label: Farnsworth showed the host the back footage by FaceTime on September 19
claims.claim: The host says that after she kept pressing him, and after he gave excuses such as fear that Google might hack him and not knowing how to send files, Farnsworth showed her the back footage by FaceTime on September 19.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's screen recording of the September 19 FaceTime and any call metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tarro showed me the back footage 2 days later on September 19th cuz I kept pressing him.

claims.label: Host recorded the FaceTime and told viewers the bullet did not go through
claims.claim: The host says she recorded the September 19 FaceTime call with Farnsworth because his energy made her uncomfortable, and that later that day she told her audience the bullet did not go through.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's September 19 episode with the recorded FaceTime.
claims.transcript_snippet: On September 19th, he did that and gratefully I moved to record that FaceTime call because his energy made me uncomfortable.

claims.label: Justin Strife repeatedly asked the host's husband whether she recorded the FaceTime
claims.claim: The host says that on September 20 Justin Strife contacted her husband several times asking whether she had recorded the FaceTime call with Farnsworth, and she reads this as a sign of panic at Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain George Farmer's message log with Justin Streiff for September 20, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: the very next day, on September 20th, Justin Strife was contacting my husband several times while asking him if I had recorded that FaceTime call with Tarro.

claims.label: Host says she told her husband not to answer the question
claims.claim: The host says her husband told her Justin Strife was urgently asking whether she had recorded something, and she told him not to answer because she found the question itself weird.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the husband's account and the message thread with Justin Streiff.
claims.transcript_snippet: Honey, don't answer the question. I find the question in and of itself to be weird.

claims.label: Host says the FBI was on the phone with Strife and Frank Carney about the back footage
claims.claim: The host says she learned that the FBI was on the phone with Justin Strife and Frank Carney that day and that they were apparently discussing with the feds whether she had recorded the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source for this account and request FBI contact logs with TPUSA leadership for September 20, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: The FBI was on the phone with Justin Strife, Frank Carney, and they were apparently speaking to the feds that day about whether or not I had recorded the footage.

claims.label: Host says September 20 was the day of Charlie's private burial
claims.claim: The host says September 20 was the exact day of Charlie Kirk's private burial and that Erika was highly concerned about the back footage that day rather than attending only to the funeral.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the date and nature of the private burial with the funeral home or family spokesperson.
claims.transcript_snippet: this was also the exact day of Charlie's private burial. And yet, this is what they were consumed with.

claims.label: Host says Erika and Andrew called Dr. Lee Trotter on the day of the funeral
claims.claim: The host says that on the day of Charlie's funeral Erika and Andrew Kolvet stepped aside and conferenced the surgeon, Dr. Lee Trotter, to craft a response about why the bullet had not gone through.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain phone records for the Erika Kirk, Andrew Kolvet and Dr. Trotter call and ask Dr. Trotter to confirm who participated.
claims.transcript_snippet: They peeled off to the side and they conferenced the surgeon on the day of Charlie's actual funeral.

claims.label: Host says Erika told her Andrew and the surgeon went rogue
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk later insisted to her face that Andrew went rogue that day and that the surgeon went rogue too, and the host says she did not believe it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any recording or notes of the host's conversation with Erika Kirk on this point.
claims.transcript_snippet: She would insist to my face and I did not believe her for 1 second and I politely pushed back that Andrew went rogue that day.

claims.label: Host says Dr. Trotter did not violate HIPAA and could sue for defamation
claims.claim: The host says Dr. Lee Trotter did not violate HIPAA and that, in her personal opinion, he could sue Erika Kirk for defamation over the claim that he did.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Dr. Trotter or his counsel whether he authorized the call and whether any HIPAA complaint was filed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Dr. Lee Trotter did not violate HIPAA. In fact, he could sue her for defamation, in my personal opinion.

claims.label: Host says Erika was on the call and said Charlie ate healthy and had a neck like Superman
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was on the phone with Andrew asking the doctor what they could tell the public, and that it was Erika who said Charlie ate healthy and had a neck like Superman.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source for who said what on the call and compare with Kolvet's September 20 post.
claims.transcript_snippet: it was Erika Kirk that said that Charlie ate healthy, and she bet he had he had he had a neck like Superman.

claims.label: Host says Kolvet told her on September 23 the bullet ran from C2 to C6 and shattered in the thorax
claims.claim: The host says that on September 23 Andrew Kolvet gave her more detail on the man-of-steel tweet, telling her the bullet traveled from C2 down to C6 and then into Charlie's thorax where it shattered, and that she took notes and would testify to this under oath.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's September 23 notes and ask Kolvet to confirm or deny the description.
claims.transcript_snippet: it traveled from C2, okay? Think about the entry point. It's almost upward. Down to C6, and then it moved downward into Charlie's thorax, where it was shattered.

claims.label: Host says the official bullet account changed three times
claims.claim: The host says the account moved from the bullet found beneath the skin, to a bullet fragmented in the thorax, to Brian Harpole saying it fragmented in the stomach or thorax, and she reads these as adjustments because the original story was failing.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's September 20 post, his September 23 account and Harpole's statement against the autopsy report.
claims.transcript_snippet: first they found the bullet uh beneath his skin. Now, suddenly, the bullet is fragmented in his thorax.

claims.label: Host theorizes the feds pivoted after the back footage ruined their plan
claims.claim: The host says her best guess is that the feds realized their initial plan was ruined by the back footage and had to pivot, first sloppily within 24 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek federal communications between September 19 and 20, 2025 about the footage and the bullet account.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's cuz at some point the feds realized that their initial plan was completely ruined by the back footage that they They had to pivot.

claims.label: Host's source says the family heirloom gun takes special bullets
claims.claim: The host says a source close to the Robinson family told her the heirloom gun takes special bullets and that the prosecution could not connect the bullets to that gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the ammunition type recovered and required by the rifle and compare with ATF and FBI reports.
claims.transcript_snippet: that family heirloom gun takes special bullets. In fact, I was told that there was no way the prosecution was going to be able to connect the bullets to that gun.

claims.label: Host says there was no reported GSR test 33 hours later
claims.claim: The host says the media is not reporting a basic gunshot residue test and asks whether one was done 33 hours later to see whether Tyler Robinson had fired a weapon, saying the prosecution cannot even prove the gun was fired.
claims.investigative_direction: Check discovery and lab reports for any GSR swabs of Robinson's hands or clothing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Did they conduct that 33 hours later to see if Tyler Robinson had fired a weapon?

claims.label: Host says the bomb dogs went into the field and did not find the weapon
claims.claim: The host says bomb dogs were taken into the field where the weapon was later found, that she broke that story, and that they did not find the weapon.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain K-9 deployment logs and handler reports for September 10 to 12, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: You remember the the bomb dogs went into the field where the weapon was found. I broke that story, and they didn't find the weapon.

claims.label: Host says her sources believe the feds planted an unfired gun
claims.claim: The host says the gun eventually found was not fired on September 10 and that her sources say they are convinced the feds planted it when they arrived.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the recovery chain of custody, the bore and chamber residue findings and the timeline of who found the weapon.
claims.transcript_snippet: which my sources say they are convinced that the feds planted it when they arrived, was not fired on September 10th, okay?

claims.label: Host says six sets of prints were found on the gun
claims.claim: The host says critics leave out that a total of six sets of prints were found on the gun, that Robinson's prints on his own gun are not shocking, and that the real question is who placed the gun in the field unfired.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the latent print report identifying the six sets and their donors.
claims.transcript_snippet: is that they found a total of six sets of prints on the gun.

claims.label: Host says SWAT, police and UVU sources say the feds are part of a conspiracy
claims.claim: The host says she has spoken to SWAT, local police departments, sources close to the accused, UVU students and people who work at UVU, and that everyone says the feds are part of a broader conspiracy.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to identify, even anonymously and with corroboration, which of these groups made the statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have spoken to SWAT, local police departments, sources close to the accused, UVU students, um people that work at UVU.

claims.label: Host rejects the claim that Robinson confessed, citing the continuance request
claims.claim: The host says the repeated claim that Tyler Robinson confessed can be dismissed because a man who confessed would not ask for a continuance to gather evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the record for any confession, including statements to family, police or the discord messages.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think we can all readily dismiss the repeated lie that Tyler Robinson confessed to his crime, right?

claims.label: Host expects Matt Robinson to be asked to identify the gun
claims.claim: The host says Matt Robinson is named as a witness and will be compelled to answer questions under oath, likely about the gun he gave Tyler, which she says is not the same as testifying for the prosecution.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the witness list and any proffer on what Matt Robinson is expected to testify to.
claims.transcript_snippet: They are naming him as a witness and he is going to be forced to answer questions under oath, likely, I would assume about the gun.

claims.label: Defense says it has requested forensic case files since September 30
claims.claim: The host reads that Robinson has not received the forensic case files and the data underlying the lab reports, and that the defense has been requesting them since September 30.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the exhibits to the motion listing each discovery request and the state's responses.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mr. Robinson has diligently requested the disclosure of forensic case files and the data underlying the laboratory reports

claims.label: Filing says the county attorney's office was also awaiting the lab files
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as saying that at the January hearing the Utah County Attorney's Office informed the defense it too was awaiting the lab files, and that the defense memorialized this in a February 3 letter.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the January hearing transcript and the February 3, 2026 defense letter.
claims.transcript_snippet: informed the defense that they too were awaiting the files and we memorialized that for the state in our February 3rd letter

claims.label: Judge said on December 11 the May hearing date was not set in stone
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as quoting the judge on December 11 as finding no prejudice in setting the preliminary hearing date and saying it is not set in stone and can certainly be moved.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the December 11, 2025 hearing transcript or minute entry.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do not find there's any prejudice in setting a date for a preliminary hearing. It's not set in stone. It certainly can be moved.

claims.label: Filing lists outstanding FBI and ATF case files and protocols
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as listing outstanding materials, including validation studies, electronic data files, the case file for the comparative bullet analysis, the bullet lead analysis still in progress at the FBI, and the ATF comparative analysis case file and protocols.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed motion and exhibits at page 11 and compare with later disclosures.
claims.transcript_snippet: validation studies, crucial electronic data files, the report, the case file for comparative bullet analysis, the the bullet lead analysis that is still in progress at the FBI

claims.label: Filing says the state will offer the autopsy report without expert testimony
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as saying that on March 12 the state indicated it intended to introduce the autopsy report into evidence without any supporting expert testimony.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed motion at page 18 and the state's witness disclosure.
claims.transcript_snippet: the state indicated that it intended to introduce the autopsy report into evidence without any supporting expert testimony.

claims.label: Host says Erika said on Fox News she wanted the case to move fast
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk said on Fox News that she just wants the case to be fast, and the host frames the discovery delay as relying on the widow's wish for speed.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Fox News interview and quote in context.
claims.transcript_snippet: Please, I just want the case to be fast, she said on Fox News.

claims.label: Filing says DNA reports show mixtures of up to five or more individuals
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as saying the FBI and ATF DNA reports recovered minute quantities of DNA on various items that the reports opine are mixtures of up to five or more individuals, and that the state will offer these without supporting expert testimony.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI and ATF DNA reports and the underlying electronic data.
claims.transcript_snippet: both agencies recovered minute quantities of DNA on various items of evidence, which the reports opine consist of mixtures of up to five or more individuals.

claims.label: Filing says the state will not offer the ATF report but the defense may call the analyst
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as saying the ATF summary report found the autopsy bullet could not be identified to the rifle, that the state has not indicated it will produce the report at the hearing, and that the defense may call the ATF analyst as exculpatory evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ATF summary report and the filed motion at the firearm evidence paragraph.
claims.transcript_snippet: Although the state has not indicated an intent to produce this report at the preliminary hearing, the defense may very well decide to offer the testimony of the ATF firearm analyst as exculpatory evidence.

claims.label: Host says the state told the defense it would not raise the ATF finding
claims.claim: The host says the state told the defense it would not even bring up the ATF result and that the defense should take its word, and she says that is not good enough because the result is exculpatory.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the March 12 conference notes between the parties.
claims.transcript_snippet: they're like, it doesn't matter. We're not going to We're not even going to bring up the ATF thing.

claims.label: Host describes bullet lead analysis as FBI technique used from the 1980s to 2004
claims.claim: The host says the compositional bullet lead analysis examined trace elements such as copper and arsenic in lead to link crime scene bullets to suspects, was used by the FBI from the 1980s until 2004, and was abandoned in 2005 for flawed scientific, statistical and interpretive validity.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with the 2004 National Academy of Sciences report on bullet lead analysis and the FBI's 2005 announcement.
claims.transcript_snippet: analyzed trace elements, uh copper, arsenic in lead to link crime scene bullets to suspects. It was primarily used by the FBI from the 1980s until 2004

claims.label: Host says bullet lead analysis put wrong people in prison
claims.claim: The host says that, as her colleague found, people have been freed because of how flawed the technique was, and that it put the wrong people in prison until nobody would stand behind it.
claims.investigative_direction: Cite the specific exoneration cases involving bullet lead analysis.
claims.transcript_snippet: They literally put the wrong people in prison using this technology until it became so obvious that nobody would even stand trial and back it anymore.

claims.label: Clip says Norma Jean Aids was shot seven times in 1991 and her husband later convicted
claims.claim: The Atlanta news clip says Norma Jean Aids was found shot to death seven times in 1991 in a home set on fire, that her husband Jimmy Aids was convicted six years later partly on bullet lead evidence from a bullet in his vehicle, and that he was released in 2021.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the station, reporter and the case's court records, noting the transcript spelling of the surname.
claims.transcript_snippet: In 1991, 45-year-old Norma Jean Aids was found inside this home, shot to death seven times.

claims.label: Filing argues hearsay summaries violate due process and other amendments
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as asserting that in a capital case the state cannot, consistent with due process and the Fourth and Eighth Amendments and separation of powers, rely on hearsay summary reports, and she says the defense has repeatedly asked for the underlying science.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed motion at page 22.
claims.transcript_snippet: the state cannot consistent with federal due process, uh the fourth and the eighth amendments and separate separation of powers

claims.label: Filing says the delay does not fall on the defense
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as stating the defense did not contribute to the delay, has diligently reviewed discovery, and has raised its concerns verbally and in writing over several months.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the defense correspondence exhibits attached to the motion.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is not our fault. We did not contribute to the delay resulting in the request.

claims.label: Filing asks for production by April 17, 2026 or vacatur of the hearing date
claims.claim: The host reads the filing as asking that, unless the requested materials are produced by April 17, 2026, the hearing date be vacated, and that if they are produced a hearing be set about six months out; the filing also calls the unproduced reports hearsay under the Utah rule of evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed motion's concluding request and the court's ruling.
claims.transcript_snippet: unless the materials that we are requesting have been produced to us by April 17th 2026, and if that does happen, then we can set a hearing um uh you know, 6 months out.

claims.label: Host says the state's text messages came as PDFs without timestamps or extraction data
claims.claim: The host says the text messages attributed to Robinson were given as a PDF without the times they came in or how they were pulled from the server, and that the defense is owed the means by which they were obtained.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the extraction reports and carrier records for the text messages cited by the state.
claims.transcript_snippet: You can't just send a PDF and then say we we got them.

claims.label: Host says she has spoken with former TPUSA employees about the lies they were told
claims.claim: The host says she has communicated with former Turning Point USA employees about the lies they were told and the way the organization has behaved and edited its story.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corroboration from at least two former employees on the specific statements said to be lies.
claims.transcript_snippet: having had communication with Turning Point USA with their former employees about the lies that they were told

claims.label: Host says a viewer emailed in response to her APB on Erika's July 14 flight
claims.claim: The host says she received an email from a woman responding to the APB she put out the previous day asking for information on Erika's July 14 flight.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the original APB post and the full emailed tip.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was a woman and she was responding to the APB that I put out yesterday regarding Erika's flight on July 14th.

claims.label: Host says Erika flew to Long Beach on July 14 with Locastro, Niekerk and Barcello
claims.claim: The host says Erika's July 14 flight was taken with Katherine Low Castro, Derek Niekerk and Jonathan Barcello, and that it goes to Long Beach.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the flight manifest or FAA flight tracking record for July 14, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: And that flight is she took with Katherine Low Castro and Derek Niekerk and Jonathan Barcello.

claims.label: Host dates the decision to kill Charlie to between June and July 13
claims.claim: The host says she feels strongly that between June and July 13 a decision was made to kill Charlie, on the basis of the Iran war and of Tucker Carlson's remarks on stage questioning Netanyahu's network and the Epstein files.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the date and transcript of the Tucker Carlson remarks and any documents showing a decision in that window.
claims.transcript_snippet: I feel very much that between June and July 13th uh is when they made a decision to kill Charlie on the basis of the Iran war

claims.label: Emailer says the Los Alamitos base is discreet and used by officials
claims.claim: The emailer says the Joint Forces Air Base entrance sits in a housing subdivision, away from heavy traffic, so it would be easy to move in and out unnoticed, that US government officials fly in and out when visiting Southern California, and that the flight from Phoenix is just over an hour.
claims.investigative_direction: Check public records of flights using Los Alamitos on July 14, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: It also is not visible to heavy traffic as the entrance to the base is located in a housing subdivision.

claims.label: Host says Charlie carefully explained to her that he was going to die
claims.claim: The host says that the moment Charlie was killed she knew he was betrayed, and that this sense may have come from his having carefully explained to her that he was going to die.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for dated messages or notes of the conversations in which Charlie said this.
claims.transcript_snippet: it could very well be that deep sense of knowing came from the fact that he had so carefully explained to me that he was going to die.

claims.label: Host says she maintains Charlie went to Utah Valley first, then Timpanogos
claims.claim: The host says Elizabeth Lane was discussing the other hospital and a strange lockdown, that she has maintained from the beginning that there was more evidence Charlie was at Utah Valley initially and then transported to Timpanogos, and that she will give an update the next day.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain hospital admission, ambulance and security records for both hospitals on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have maintained from the beginning that there was more evidence that Charlie was at Utah Valley uh initially, and then at some point got transported to Timpanogos

claims.label: Host relays that Turek said Kirk was dead within 30 minutes and asked to talk to Erika
claims.claim: The host relays her producer's point that Frank Turek's next sentence was that Charlie was dead and he needed to talk to Erika, about 30 minutes after Charlie was rushed to the hospital, and asks how he knew Erika's first name.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Turek's full account and the hospital's time of death record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Within 30 minutes, they tell us that he's declared dead. How did he know Erika was his wife's name?

claims.label: Host says Erika told her she had no part in the doctor discussion
claims.claim: The host says that, regarding the surgeon's alleged HIPAA violation, Erika told her she had no part in it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's notes of the conversation with Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: I guess they didn't technically tweet that. She told me that. Um but that she didn't she had no part in it.

claims.label: Host says that under a cover-up the TPUSA figures are tied together and one takes the blame
claims.claim: The host says that if the cover-up theory is correct the people involved are tied to each other, as Baron Coleman explains, and whoever has to be the bad guy that day takes the hits, for example making Andrew look like a dunce.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek documents or witnesses showing coordinated messaging among TPUSA leaders.
claims.transcript_snippet: Make him Andrew the dunce and say, "Oh, he doesn't know what he was doing."
